scene rikaimanigym1
: Ahem.
lines.zh: : 咳嗯。

lines.en: scene rikaimanigym2
scene rikaimanigym3
: Imani?...
lines.zh: : Imani?……

lines.en: : What are you doing in my bed?...
lines.zh: : 你怎么在我床上?……

lines.en: scene rikaimanigym4
: This is my bed. And you appear to be naked in it.
lines.zh: : 这是我的床。而你看起来一丝不挂地在里面。

lines.en: : Oh...yeah. Weird. Shouldn’t you be naked too then? I don’t think it’s normal for only one person to be like that.
lines.zh: : 哦……对。怪。那你不也该光着吗?就一个人光着,我觉得不正常。

lines.en: : Then why don’t you turn around and see who else is here?
lines.zh: : 那你何不转过身,看看这里还有谁?

lines.en: : What? But- OH MY GOD!
lines.zh: : 什么?可是——我的天!

lines.en: scene rikaimanigym5
: Shhh! You’re gonna wake him up!
lines.zh: : 那不是春梦?!我和 Akira 真的……

lines.en: scene rikaimanigym6
: That wasn’t a sex dream?! Did me and Akira actually...
lines.zh: : 你经常做关于他的春梦吗?

lines.en: : Do you have sex dreams about him often?
lines.zh: : 经常。这不正常吗?

lines.en: scene rikaimanigym7
: Yes. Is that not normal?

lines.zh: : 哦,对。我大概该道歉。

lines.en: : Oh, right. I should probably be apologizing.
lines.zh: : 不过请容我辩解,我一定是醉得不行了。因为我记得的全部,就是策划了一个让他招供「想上 Rin」的计划。

lines.en: : But, in my defense, I must have been very drunk. Because all I can remember is coming up with a plan to make him confess to wanting to bone Rin.
lines.zh: : 那计划的收尾可真别致,我得说。

lines.en: : Weird ending to that plan, I’ve gotta say.
lines.zh: : 你在生我的气吗?万一你也有份呢?你还记得什么?也许我们做了,只是让他看着。你可不知道那没发生。

lines.en: : Are you mad at me? What if you were involved? What do you remember? Maybe we did it and just made him watch. You don’t know that’s what didn’t happen.
lines.zh: : 我还真知道。因为你不省人事之前,给我发了条短信,写着:「抱歉性爱 Akira。好晕。巨大肉棒。性爱好。醉了。性爱好。爱你。」

lines.en: : I do actually. Because you had the bright idea of sending me a text before passing out that said, “Sorry sex Akira. So dizzy. Huge dick. Good sex. Drunk. Sex good. Love you.”
lines.zh: : 嗯,至少我说了爱你。那意味着我被原谅了,对吧?

lines.en: : Well, at least I said I love you. That means I’m forgiven, right?
lines.zh: : 严格来讲,你没有什么可被原谅的。我们又不算正式交往什么的。

lines.en: scene rikaimanigym8
: There’s nothing to forgive you for if you want to get technical about it. It’s not like we’re official or anything.
lines.zh: : 加上,你清醒的时候就是个白痴。我不能指望你醉了还理性行事。只是下次别在我床上,行吗?

lines.en: : Plus, you’re an idiot when you’re not drunk. I can’t expect you to act rationally when you are. Just maybe not in my bed next time, please?
lines.zh: : 行,好。说实话我自己都不明白怎么发生的。我最近「不和人上床」的功课做得太好了,我都感觉自己快成职业选手了。

lines.en: : Sure, yeah. I honestly don’t even understand how it happened. I’ve been so good at not having sex with people lately that I felt like I was about to go pro at it.
lines.zh: : 嗯,往好处想,我们现在又多了一个共同点。只是可惜,接下来得为它竞争了。

lines.en: scene rikaimanigym9
: Well, on the bright side, we’ve got one more thing in common now. Just sucks that we’re going to have to be competing over it.
lines.zh: : 竞争?什么?不可能。他是你的。我们俩都烂醉时搞在一起,不代表我会试图把他从你手里抢走。

lines.en: : Competing? What? No way. He’s yours. Just because we hooked up while we were both hammered doesn’t mean I’m going to try and steal him away from you.
lines.zh: : 他当时也醉了吧?我不记得了。

lines.en: : Was he drunk too? I don’t remember.
lines.zh: : 他肯定也醉了,对吧?我们的计划不可能败得那么惨。就是……我们让他招供了吗?我们现在知道真相了吗?

lines.en: : He had to be, right? There’s no way our plan would fail that badly. Like...did we get him to confess? Do we know the truth now?
lines.zh: : 我本来指望你知道呢。我记得的只有吐在他腿上。

lines.en: : I was really hoping you would. All I remember is throwing up on his lap.
lines.zh: : 然后我还和他睡了?我到底有什么毛病?

lines.en: : And I still had sex with him? What the hell is wrong with me?
lines.zh: : 嘿,我懂。不久前我也在同一条船上。

lines.en: scene rikaimanigym10
: Hey, I get it. I was in the same boat as you not so long ago.
lines.zh: : 是……虽然我确实感觉心里翻腾的疯狂慢了下来,但我还是觉得,到最后没拿到答案,实在没用。

lines.en: : Sure...and while I do feel like the madness bubbling up within me has slowed down a little, I still feel like coming out of this without an answer isn’t really useful.
lines.zh: : 那你有什么建议?我们再把他灌醉一次?

lines.en: : What are you suggesting then? We get him drunk again?
lines.zh: : 哦噢!好主意!这次我们拍下来!

lines.en: scene rikaimanigym11
: Oooh! Good idea! We just film it this time!
lines.zh: : Rika——

lines.en: : Rika-
lines.zh: : 然后等我们俩再昏过去,就一起看录像带!我这个年纪之后就再没在镜头前光过身子了!我好奇!

lines.en: : And then watch the tape together if we both pass out again! I haven’t been naked on film since I was your age! I’m curious!
lines.zh: : Rika,我在开玩笑。灌醉他第一次就没用,我们离真相一点也没近。真想知道的话,为什么不直接问他?

lines.en: : Rika, I was joking. Getting him drunk didn’t work the first time and we’re still no closer to knowing the truth. Why don’t we just ask him if we really want to know?
lines.zh: : 我问过了,记得吗?他一口否认,还说他会让 Rin 收手。

lines.en: scene rikaimanigym12
: I did, remember? And he flat out denied it and told me he’d get Rin to back off.
lines.zh: : 嗯,我想等她发现你和他睡了,那事就容易多了。

lines.en: : Well, I imagine that’ll be a lot easier once she finds out you slept with him.
lines.zh: : 我不想让她知道那个!就算那能让她重新觉得我够朋克!她的心已经碎过一百万次了!

lines.en: scene rikaimanigym13
: I don’t want her to know that! Even if it gets her to think I’m punk again! She’s already had her heart broken a million times!
lines.zh: : 那不才……两次吗?

lines.en: : Hasn’t it only been, like...two?
lines.zh: : 青少年纪年的一百万次!你当过小孩吗?!

lines.en: : That’s like a million in teenager years! Weren’t you ever a kid?!
lines.zh: : Rika……就让我和他谈,好吗?Senpai 不会吃套路那一套。除非他……真的已经吃过了,而我们只是醉得太狠记不得。

lines.en: : Rika...just let me talk to him, okay? Senpai’s not going to respond to tricks. Unless he...literally did already and we just can’t remember it because we got too drunk.
lines.zh: : 除非你有更好的主意,那就是。

lines.en: : Unless you have a better idea, that is.
lines.zh: : 并没有。我的头还因为喝太多一团糟。而且不知道为什么,我整条下半身有点麻木。

lines.en: scene rikaimanigym14
: Not really. My head’s still fucked up from drinking so much. And my entire lower body feels kind of numb for some reason.
lines.zh: : 嗯。你会习惯的。

lines.en: : Yeah. You’ll get used to that.
lines.zh: : 那现在的计划是什么?就……聊聊?你们俩?单独?而我在角落里假装自己也很重要?

lines.en: : What’s the plan now then? Just...talk? You guys? Alone? While I wait in the corner and pretend to also be important?
lines.zh: : 我想先让头疼过去,再进行那种讨论。我想昨晚是我人生第一次断片。至少……是因为酒精,而不是因为创伤性的身体虐待。

lines.en: : I want this headache to go away before having a discussion like that. I think last night was the first time I’ve ever blacked out. At least...due to alcohol and not traumatic physical abuse.
lines.zh: : 哦!那个!创伤性的身体虐待!我们可以用这个让他招供!

lines.en: scene rikaimanigym15
: Oh! That! Traumatic physical abuse! That’s how we can get him to confess!
lines.zh: : Kwesi?你在里面吗?从我朋友的脑子里出来。

lines.en: : Kwesi? That you in there? Get out of my friend’s head.
lines.zh: : Imani,Akira 最恨什么?

lines.en: : Imani, what does Akira hate more than anything?
lines.zh: : Imani,Akira 最恨什么?

lines.en: : I honestly don’t even know where to begin.
lines.zh: : 说实话,我连从哪开始数都不知道。

lines.en: : Hard work! We’ve just gotta team up and push his hunky body past its physical limits! Consensually, of course.
lines.zh: : 辛苦!我们只要组队,把他那副壮硕身躯推过生理极限就行了!当然,是经他同意的。

lines.en: : Like...like a threesome?
lines.zh: : 像……像三人行?

lines.en: scene rikaimanigym16
: No. Something even better.
lines.zh: : 不。还有更好的。

lines.en: scene rikaimanigym17
: This!
lines.zh: : 这个!

lines.en: : So, I get what you’re going for and do think this will be more effective in the long run. But I question exactly why you would call this “better.”
lines.zh: : 所以,我明白你的用意,也确实认为长远来看这样更有效。但我很怀疑,你为什么会管这个叫「更好」。

lines.en: : Easy! I lied! I just didn’t want last night affecting my morning routine since missing one gym day inevitably leads to missing all of them!
lines.zh: : 简单!我撒谎了!我只是不想让昨晚影响我的晨间流程——毕竟缺一天健身房,必然导致缺掉所有天!

lines.en: : Why am I here?
lines.zh: : 我为什么在这里?

lines.en: scene rikaimanigym18
: In fact, who am I? I consumed so much alcohol last night that I believe I may have amnesia.
lines.zh: : 事实上,我是谁?我昨晚喝了太多酒,我觉得我可能失忆了。

lines.en: : You fucker. You remember everything, don’t you?
lines.zh: : 你这混账。你全都记得,对吧?

lines.en: : Nope. Just that you owe me a new pair of pants.
lines.zh: : 并没有。只记得你欠我一条新裤子。

lines.en: scene rikaimanigym19
: I may have started it, sure. But this is really on Rika for not knowing how to use a washing machine.
lines.zh: : 起头的人可能是我,没错。但这真得怪 Rika,谁让她连洗衣机都不会用。

lines.en: : I got help this time!
lines.zh: : 这次我求助了!

lines.en: : Yeah! From me!
lines.zh: : 对!求助了我!

lines.en: : I’m just glad the gym has a coin laundry in it.
lines.zh: : 我只是庆幸健身房里自带投币洗衣房。

lines.en: scene rikaimanigym20
: And also that the front door was unlocked. I actually don’t think we’re supposed to be here right now.
lines.zh: : 也庆幸大门没锁。我真的觉得,我们现在不该出现在这里。

lines.en: : Yeah, you’re definitely not.
lines.zh: : 嗯,你们绝对不该。

lines.en: scene rikaimanigym21
: Ahh! Cancer!
lines.zh: : 啊!癌症!

lines.en: : Yes, hello. It is me. Cancer.
lines.zh: : 是,你好。是我。癌症。

lines.en: : I mean Yuki! Pretty woman! You are here!
lines.zh: : 我是说 Yuki!漂亮女人!你在这里!

lines.en: scene rikaimanigym22
: I didn’t realize you were still coming. I hadn’t seen you since we came together.
lines.zh: : 我不知道你今天还来。自从我们上次一起来过之后,就没见过你。

lines.en: : Because I wasn’t. It’s just an excuse to get me out of the damn manor. Didn’t think Tsubasa would flat out buy the gym to keep an eye on me, though.
lines.zh: : 因为我没来。那只是把我从那座该死公馆里弄出来的借口。不过我没想到,Tsubasa 会直接买下健身房来盯着我。

lines.en: scene rikaimanigym23
: Tsubasa...so that is the name of my arch nemesis. I’ll just have to buy a bigger gym.
lines.zh: : Tsubasa……原来这就是我宿敌的名字。那我只好多买一座更大的健身房。

lines.en: : You and what income?
lines.zh: : 就凭你那点收入?

lines.en: : How are you feeling, Yuki? Any better?
lines.zh: : 你感觉怎么样,Yuki?好点了吗?

lines.en: : Pretty good, all things considered. You should drop by more often. Easier to give you updates that way.
lines.zh: : 总体而言相当不错。你该多过来坐坐。这样汇报近况更容易。

lines.en: : You could always just text me, you know.
lines.zh: : 你随时可以给我发短信,知道的吧。

lines.en: : I could. Can’t see your face that way, though.
lines.zh: : 我可以。但那样就看不到你的脸了。

lines.en: scene rikaimanigym24
: Okay! My turn for attention!
lines.zh: : 好!轮到我讨关注了!

lines.en: scene rikaimanigym25
: I’m gonna go catch up with Yuki and see if I’m still allowed to come here after today! I’ll meet back up with you guys in a minute!
lines.zh: : 我要去和 Yuki 叙叙旧,顺便看看今天之后我还被不允许来这里!一会儿和你们汇合!

lines.en: : But I-
lines.zh: : 可是我——

lines.en: : I want updates too! We’re gym buddies, remember?! I care! Probably too much. But that just means I need to know!
lines.zh: : 我也要听汇报!我们是健身房搭子,记得吗?!我在乎!可能在乎过头了。但那就意味着我必须知道!

lines.en: : Hah...I guess it can’t be helped. Come on. I already scouted out the blind spots where I can sneak a cig without being noticed.
lines.zh: : 哈……那也没办法。来吧。我已经踩好了几个盲区,可以在那里偷抽一根不被发现。

lines.en: : Oh, not on my watch. Yoink!
lines.zh: : 哦,别当我面想得美。嗖——没收!

lines.en: : Hey! Give those back!
lines.zh: : 嘿!还给我!

lines.en: Rika and Yuki exit the gym together just a mere five minutes after we arrive, leaving me alone with Imani in what I’m sure will momentarily dissolve into a mildly heartfelt conversation about drinking responsibly.
lines.zh: Rika 和 Yuki 在我们到达后仅仅五分钟便一同离开健身房,留下我和 Imani 独处——我确信,这片刻很快会溶成一场关于「理性饮酒」的、略微掏心窝子的对话。

lines.en: : Hah...
scene rikaimanigym26
: So, how was it?
lines.zh: : 那么,感觉如何?

lines.en: : How was what?
lines.zh: : 什么感觉如何?

lines.en: : Don’t play dumb, Senpai. I know you had sex with Rika.
lines.zh: : 别装傻,Senpai。我知道你和 Rika 睡了。

lines.en: : Did the fact that we were both naked when you woke up give that away?
lines.zh: : 你醒来时我们都光着身子这一点,是不是已经暴露了?

lines.en: : That and her not so subtle text about the size of your penis and how good sex is.
lines.zh: : 还有她那条毫不含蓄的短信——关于你肉棒的尺寸,和性爱有多好。

lines.en: : That family has a problem when it comes to texting things they shouldn’t.
lines.zh: : 那一家人在「把不该发的东西发出去」这方面,是有毛病的。

lines.en: scene rikaimanigym27
: So, how much did you wind up telling us before we both got completely smashed?
lines.zh: : 那么,在我们俩彻底烂醉之前,你到底说出了多少?

lines.en: : Nothing really. But that was mostly due to the fact that you guys were drunk before I even figured out what was going on and not because I was trying to keep anything secret.
lines.zh: : 基本什么都没说。但那多半是因为,我还没搞清状况你们就已经醉了——并不是我刻意想瞒什么。

lines.en: : You’ll be honest now then? Since we’re both completely sober?
lines.zh: : 那你现在愿意说实话了?既然我们都完全清醒?

lines.en: : Honest about what? I am an oblivious, stupid man who lacks the ability to pick up on social and contextual clues.
lines.zh: : 说什么实话?我是一个迟钝又愚蠢、缺乏解读社交与语境线索能力的男人。

lines.en: scene rikaimanigym28
: You know, silence can be really deafening in certain contexts, Senpai. I’d almost prefer you just lie to me at this point.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗,Senpai,沉默在某些语境下震耳欲聋。事到如今,我几乎希望你直接骗我。

lines.en: scene rikaimanigym29
: And what would lying accomplish exactly?
lines.zh: : 撒谎又能达成什么?

lines.en: : What does hiding something from your best friend accomplish?
lines.zh: : 瞒着最好的朋友,又能达成什么?

lines.en: : Are you not hiding anything from me?
lines.zh: : 你就没有瞒着我什么吗?

lines.en: : Not anymore. I told you why I look the way I do and that was the only thing I was actively keeping from you. And even then, it was just because I felt ashamed.
lines.zh: : 没有了。我告诉过你我为什么会是现在这副样子,那是我唯一在主动向你隐瞒的事。即便如此,也只是因为羞耻。

lines.en: : You’re not the only one who feels shame. And you were certainly hiding something from me last night too.
lines.zh: : 感到羞耻的又不只你一个。而且昨晚,你 certainly 也在瞒着我什么。

lines.en: : I never expected Rika’s plan to work, honestly. It just seemed like the easiest way to confront you about a topic that isn’t really easy to broach.
lines.zh: : 说实话,我从没指望 Rika 的计划能成。它只是个最简单的由头,好让我提起那个不容易开口的话题。

lines.en: : And I imagine it’s one you’ve wanted to broach for a while now, huh?
lines.zh: : 而我猜,那个话题你想提有一阵子了,嗯?

lines.en: scene rikaimanigym30
: Be straight with me, Senpai. How far has it gone?
lines.zh: : 跟我直说,Senpai。走到哪一步了?

lines.en: : Imani-
lines.zh: : Imani——

lines.en: : Like, have you actually done anything? Or is this just some sort of Pied Piper situation where you extract some sort of personal value from leading on an entire class of girls who like you?
lines.zh: : 就是说,你们真的做过什么了吗?还是说,这只是一场「吹笛人」式的局面——你从「带领一整班喜欢你的女孩」这件事里,榨取某种个人价值?

lines.en: : I like you, Imani. Am I leading you on too?
lines.zh: : 我喜欢你,Imani。我也在 leading 你吗?

lines.en: : Not necessarily. You just seemed to like me a lot more when I was cosplaying as a schoolgirl.
lines.zh: : 未必。只是你似乎在我 cosplay 女学生的时候,喜欢我要多得多。

lines.en: : But it was your idea to do that, so you clearly understand the appeal.
lines.zh: : 可那是你的主意,所以你显然明白那种吸引力。

lines.en: : Of course I understand the appeal. This is fucking Japan, yo. The appeal is everywhere. The sexualization is everywhere. And we all participate in it whether we like it or not.
lines.zh: : 我当然明白那种吸引力。这里可是他妈的日本,哥们。吸引力无处不在。性化无处不在。无论我们喜不喜欢,我们全都参与其中。

lines.en: : And I’m not saying that’s right — just a lot more morally ambiguous than getting lost in the sauce and crossing lines you’re smart enough to know you shouldn’t.
lines.zh: : 我也不是说那就对了——只是比起烂醉如泥、跨过你明明聪明到知道不该跨的线,前者在道德上要模糊得多。

lines.en: : And don’t go stalling for time while you wait for Rika to get rejected again. Just talk to me.
lines.zh: : 也别趁等着 Rika 再次被拒的空当拖延时间。直接和我谈。

lines.en: : I don’t know how much you remember from last night, but I tried to.
lines.zh: : 我不知道你昨晚记得多少,但我试着坦白过。

lines.en: scene rikaimanigym31
: Well, why’d you stop? That could have been a breakthrough.
lines.zh: : 嗯,那你为什么停了?那本来可以是个突破口。

lines.en: : I stopped because that’s when you threw up all over my pants.
lines.zh: : 我停下,是因为那时候你吐了我一裤子。

lines.en: scene rikaimanigym32
: Oh.
: Well, yeah...I guess that would do it. But you can tell me now then, right? As a friend. Not a coworker.
lines.zh: : 嗯,对……我猜那确实会坏事。但你现在可以告诉我了吧?以朋友的身份。不是同事。

lines.en: : It’s not just as a friend either though since I’ve made it apparent you’re more to me than that.
lines.zh: : 而且还不只是朋友——我已经明说过,你对我而言不止于此。

lines.en: scene rikaimanigym33
: I’m happy to hear that, obviously...But there’s a time and a place for flattery and this is certainly not it.
lines.zh: : 听到这话我当然高兴……但恭维也讲究时间和场合,现在 certainly 不是。

lines.en: : Those girls are like daughters to me, in a way. Like yeah, they’re annoying as fuck sometimes. But they’ve made me a better person, weirdly enough.
lines.zh: : 某种意义上,那些女孩就像我的女儿。是的,她们有时候烦人得要死。但说来奇怪,是她们让我变成了更好的人。

lines.en: : That’s why I’m always trying to go above and beyond for them. And I’m sure there’s an argument to be made about how teachers should just always do that, but...I don’t know.
lines.zh: : 所以我总是想为她们多做一点、再多做一点。当然,肯定有人能论证「老师本来就该这样」,但是……我不知道。

lines.en: : Maybe it’s just because they’re the first class I’ve ever been with full-time...but they really do feel more like family than students to me at this point.
lines.zh: : 也许只因为她们是我带过的第一届全日制班级……但到了这一步,她们对我来说真的更像家人,而不是学生。

lines.en: : Just this family is far more accepting than the one I had. So I’ve got this primal urge to just...protect them.
lines.zh: : 只不过这个家,远比我原本那个家宽容。所以我身体里有种原始的冲动,就是……保护她们。

lines.en: : And you’re worried you have to protect them from me.
lines.zh: : 而你担心的是,你得保护她们不被我伤害。

lines.en: : I’m thinking of them like little kids at a zoo and you as a lion who escaped its cage.
lines.zh: : 我把她们想象成动物园里的小孩,而你是逃出笼子的狮子。

lines.en: : You’re cute and fluffy and they all want to pet you, but you could snap at any moment and completely annihilate them. That’s what I want to avoid.
lines.zh: : 你可爱又毛茸茸,她们都想摸摸你,可你随时可能张口,把他们彻底咬碎。那是我想避免的。

lines.en: : Do you think I don’t care about them then, Imani?
lines.zh: : 那你觉得我不在乎她们吗,Imani?

lines.en: scene rikaimanigym34
: No, I know you do. That’s why I never felt the need to bring this up and always just told myself I was being ridiculous.
lines.zh: : 不,我知道你在乎。正因如此,我从来没觉得有必要提起这些,总告诉自己是我多心了。

lines.en: : But it’s gotten a lot more real lately. And if Rika is starting to worry about her actual daughter as a result of it, I shouldn’t just ignore it any longer.
lines.zh: : 但最近,这件事变得真实多了。如果连 Rika 都因此开始担心她的亲生女儿,我不该再视而不见。

lines.en: : I never should have to begin with. I should have cleared this up the moment I first heard anything inappropriate. But I wanted them to like me and I wanted to be cool.
lines.zh: : 我本来就不该视而不见。第一次听到任何不妥的苗头时,我就该把话说清。但我想让她们喜欢我,我想当个酷的人。

lines.en: : I wanted you to like me too.
lines.zh: : 我也想让你喜欢我。

lines.en: : I like being liked, Senpai. I don’t want to be the bad guy.
lines.zh: : 我喜欢被人喜欢,Senpai。我不想当坏人。

lines.en: : Neither do I. I just...I don’t know.
lines.zh: : 我也不想。我只是……我不知道。

lines.en: : What’s there to not know? Either you’ve crossed a line or you haven’t. There’s no nuance here. It’s just yes or no.
lines.zh: : 有什么不知道的?你要么越了线,要么没有。这里没有细微差别。只有「是」或「否」。

lines.en: : There is nuance, though. I just can’t really address it without sounding like either a psychopath or someone who doesn’t take your concerns seriously. Which I do. It’s just...complicated.
lines.zh: : 但有细微差别。只是我一旦解释,听起来不是像个精神变态,就是像不把你的担忧当回事。而我在乎。只是……复杂。

lines.en: : Because of what happened to you when you were young?
lines.zh: : 因为你小时候发生的事?

lines.en: : Well...no? That’s not exactly what I had in mind. It definitely doesn’t help, though.
lines.zh: : 嗯……不?那不是我想的。不过它确实于事无补。

lines.en: : What then? Help me understand how you’re a victim here too. Because I’d love nothing more than to be able to believe that, Senpai.
lines.zh: : 那是什么?帮帮我,让我理解你为什么也是受害者。因为再没有比能相信这一点,更让我高兴的事了,Senpai。

lines.en: : I’ll just...okay. Imagine time stopped moving. And you stayed the way you are now for the rest of forever.
lines.zh: : 我就……好吧。想象时间停止了流动。而你就以现在的模样,度过此后的永远。

lines.en: : Would you just keep looking at everyone younger than you as children for the rest of eternity? Even if they were still growing mentally?
lines.zh: : 你会在永恒里,一直把所有比你年轻的人当成小孩看吗?哪怕他们的心智仍在成长?

lines.en: : That’s...a question alright. I don’t know. Probably not? That’s not how this works, though.
lines.zh: : 那……确实是个问题。我不知道。大概不会?但这不是这么运作的。

lines.en: : Time is moving. And in a few years, most of these girls are going to be going off to college and really starting their lives. It’s just our job to make sure they survive high school.
lines.zh: : 时间在流动。几年之后,这些女孩大多会上大学,真正开始她们的人生。我们唯一的工作,是确保她们活着走出高中。

lines.en: : Yeah, well...I agree with that. And I can promise you that, no matter what happens, that much isn’t going to change.
lines.zh: : 嗯,这个……我同意。而且我可以向你保证,无论发生什么,这一点不会改变。

lines.en: : And if you want any proof of that, just look at how I don’t come to school anymore. That’s for their benefit mostly. I just also happen to profit off it in a sense.
lines.zh: : 如果你想要任何证明,看看我如今为什么不来学校就知道了。那主要是为她们好。只是某种意义上,我也恰好从中获利。

lines.en: scene rikaimanigym35
: Sure do. Still collecting a paycheck despite doing literally nothing at 31 is a life most people wouldn’t even dream of, Senpai. Yet you’re out here thriving.
lines.zh: : 还真获利了。31 岁,什么都没干,照领工资——这是大多数人做梦都不敢想的人生,Senpai。而你在外面活得风生水起。

lines.en: : “Thriving” is a bit too generous, Imani. Not a day goes by where I don’t contemplate throwing myself off a building.
lines.zh: : 「风生水起」未免太慷慨了,Imani。我没有哪一天不在盘算从某栋楼上跳下去。

lines.en: : I wonder what this world would be like if everyone was as good at playing the victim as you.
lines.zh: : 我好奇,如果所有人都和你一样擅长扮演受害者,这个世界会是什么样。

lines.en: : Probably horrible. But it’s not like it’s that great in the first place, so...
lines.zh: : 大概很糟。但话说回来,它本来也没多好,所以……

lines.en: scene rikaimanigym36
: It’s not that bad. Depressing and tempting, sure. But I think there’s enough good stuff out there to offset all the misery. Really comes down to what you surround yourself with.
lines.zh: : 没那么糟。令人消沉、充满诱惑,的确。但我觉得世上美好之物还是够多,足以抵消所有的苦难。关键还是看你让自己置身于什么之中。

lines.en: : Then that’s probably why you’re so happy and I’m so...nothing.
lines.zh: : 那大概就是为什么你那么幸福,而我这么……空虚。

lines.en: : Keep me close and just leech off my energy then. Or Rika’s, I guess...since that’s a thing now.
lines.zh: : 那就把我留在身边,吸我的能量好了。或者吸 Rika 的,我猜……既然现在有这么回事了。

lines.en: : Right. Yes. But before you think I took advantage of her-
lines.zh: : 对。是。不过在你以为是我占了便宜之前——

lines.en: : She totally started it. I know.
lines.zh: : 完全是她先动的手。我知道。

lines.en: : Good. Now we can begin the moral debate on which is more acceptable to hook up with — a dangerously inebriated MILF or a completely sober, mentally mature high-schooler.
lines.zh: : 很好。那我们现在可以开始道德辩论了:和哪种人 hook up 更可接受——一个烂醉如泥的危险 MILF,还是一个完全清醒、心智成熟的高中生。

lines.en: : The trick is to just hook-up with your best friend and avoid both of those things completely.
lines.zh: : 诀窍是直接和最好的朋友在一起,把这两样全都绕开。

lines.en: : That’s the one I want the most right now, for sure. That smile kills me every time.
lines.zh: : 那确实是我此刻最想要的。那个笑容每次都要我的命。

lines.en: : Again, there’s a time and a place for flattery, Senpai. And I politely ask that you abstain from saying things that make me like you more until I find out how fucked up you really are.
lines.zh: : 再说一遍,恭维讲究时间和场合,Senpai。在我查清你到底有多烂之前,请恕我请求你别说那些会让我更喜欢你的话。

lines.en: : Put the schoolgirl outfit back on and we can find out together.
lines.zh: : 把女学生制服穿回去,我们就可以一起查了。

lines.en: : You’re sick. What do you want to drink?
lines.zh: : 你有病。你想喝什么?

lines.en: : Some cyanide, maybe?
lines.zh: : 来点氰化物,如何?

lines.en: : How about some water? Rika’s planning on “pushing you past your physical limits” today and I don’t want you getting dehydrated before you can confess to your sins.
lines.zh: : 来点水怎么样?Rika 计划今天「把你的身体推过极限」,我可不想你在招供罪行之前先脱水。

lines.en: : Works for me. And...Imani?
lines.zh: : 可以。还有……Imani?

lines.en: : Yeah?
: I think it’s okay to stop covering up so much during times like this. You’ll overheat working out in that.
lines.zh: : 我觉得,这种时候你不用遮得那么严实。穿成这样锻炼,你会中暑的。

lines.en: : Different conversation, Senpai. But thank you.
lines.zh: : 这是另一个话题了,Senpai。不过谢谢。

lines.en: : I’ll think about it.
lines.zh: : 我会考虑的。

lines.en: scene black
Imani pulls herself off the bench and heads to the door, leaving me alone with an array of workout machines I don’t know how to operate.
lines.zh: Imani 从长凳上起身,朝门口走去,留我和一排我不知道怎么操作的健身器械独处。

lines.en: As such, I simply pace around the room and increase my step count for the day.
lines.zh: 于是,我干脆在房间里踱步,为今天多刷一点步数。

lines.en: I have now sufficiently exercised and can return to figuring out whether or not it’s safe to tell Imani that I am, in fact, the scum of the earth.
lines.zh: 现在我已经充分锻炼过了,可以回去继续琢磨:告诉 Imani「我其实就是人渣」这件事,到底安不安全。

lines.zh: Imani 的好感度提升到了 [imani_love]!
